notes: THREE THINGS THE APP COULD READ BUT YOU COULD NEVER ENTER. YOU CAN NOW ENTER WHAT YOUR POOLS ALREADY HELD. Capital allowances shipped able to work a pool out from your asset register, which is right for a business that has kept every asset since it began and wrong for everybody else. A pool carries a WRITTEN-DOWN VALUE forward from the last computation filed with the Authority, and there was nowhere to put it. Capital Allowances, Balances brought forward: give the class, the year the figure is brought forward AT, and the value. Assets bought before that year are treated as already inside the figure and are not counted twice, and the schedule says so if your register also holds some. Entering the same class and year again CORRECTS the figure rather than adding a second, and where two exist for a class the LATER one is used. THE EMPLOYEE UPLOAD NOW CARRIES THE GRA FIELDS. The employer return (DT 0107A) asks for each employee position, residency class, whether they hold secondary employment and whether SSNIT was paid. The employee FORM asked for all four. The UPLOAD did not, so an employer importing a staff list got blanks in those columns with nothing to say why. The upload now takes them, and two details matter. Residency is checked AS YOU IMPORT: the Authority sheet compares that cell against exactly four words — Resident-Full-Time, Resident-Part-Time, Resident-Casual, Non-Resident — and rates anything else at nothing, so a different spelling is now refused by row and told what the four are, rather than accepted and quietly ignored by the Authority. And A BLANK STAYS NOT STATED: for secondary employment and SSNIT paid an empty cell is left unanswered rather than filled in as No, because answering a question on a filed return that you never answered is worse than a visible blank. ASSETS. The asset form already asks for the capital allowance class, and only when you have turned the schedule on; that is unchanged. There is still no bulk upload for assets — they are entered one at a time — which is worth knowing if you are adopting the schedule with a large register. NO DATA CHANGES; this installs straight over the previous version. Please still take a backup first: Backup & Export, Back up now.
